title: Smog, Google's Slide, and the Chained Door
titleZh: 雾霾、谷歌大跌与锁链门
description: Steven covers Beijing's heavy smog, Alphabet's oversold slide and other stock picks, and a confused Canadian's take on the US midterm elections. He also connects a Chinese company's unbreakable glass to the chained fire door in his building, then reports on his students' rocky midterm rehearsal.

sentences.zh: 本期速览
sentences.en: This Episode at a Glance

sentences.zh: 本期节目里，史蒂文聊了北京浓重的雾霾、被“砸”得不轻的谷歌股价，还有他终于想弄明白的美国中期选举。
sentences.en: In this episode, Steven talks about Beijing's heavy smog, Google's badly "smashed" stock price, and the US midterm elections, which he's finally trying to figure out.

sentences.zh: 接着，他说到一家中国玻璃公司：法国的暴徒据说怎么也砸不碎它的玻璃。
sentences.en: Next, he talks about a Chinese glass company: rioters in France supposedly just couldn't smash its glass.

sentences.zh: 这让他想到了自家楼里那扇被锁链拴住的门。
sentences.en: This reminds him of the door in his own building that's held shut with a chain.

sentences.zh: 最后，他聊到对他来说最要紧的“期中考试”：学生们的期中考。
sentences.en: Finally, he talks about the "midterms" that matter most to him: his students' midterm exams.

sentences.zh: 灰蒙蒙的天，和跑步机的“续命”
sentences.en: Gray skies, and the treadmill's new lease on life

sentences.zh: 今晚，史蒂文望向窗外，屋顶上方是粉色的晚霞，可横在他和晚霞之间的，是他在北京很久没见过的厚厚雾霾。
sentences.en: Tonight, Steven looked out the window at the pink sunset glow above the rooftops, but between him and the sunset lay a thick smog he hadn't seen in Beijing for a long time.

sentences.zh: AQI 在 165 到 192 之间。
sentences.en: The AQI was between 165 and 192.

sentences.zh: 他说：“这不是雾，是霾。”
sentences.en: He said, "This isn't fog, it's smog."

sentences.zh: 预计明晚会降到绿色的 45，周五又会重新变脏。
sentences.en: It's forecast to drop to a green 45 tomorrow night, and then get dirty again on Friday.

sentences.zh: 原因呢？
sentences.en: And the reason?

sentences.zh: 他也不知道，也许是中国在加大生产，也许是厄尔尼诺。
sentences.en: He doesn't know either; maybe China is ramping up production, maybe it's El Niño.

sentences.zh: 所以他庆幸自己没把跑步机处理掉，不过他还是更喜欢在户外跑，因为那 45 到 50 分钟正好可以远离电子设备。
sentences.en: So he's glad he didn't get rid of the treadmill, though he still prefers running outdoors, because those 45 to 50 minutes are the perfect chance to get away from electronic devices.

sentences.zh: AI 仪表盘： 现在到处都是。
sentences.en: AI dashboards: they're everywhere now.

sentences.zh: 他自嘲：“它到底有没有帮我多做出一点内容？还是我只是在不同的 AI 工具之间瞎折腾？”
sentences.en: He joked at his own expense: "Has it actually helped me produce any more content? Or am I just messing around between different AI tools?"

sentences.zh: 暖气： 集中供暖通常要到 11 月中旬才来，所以现在脚趾冻得发凉。
sentences.en: Heating: central heating usually doesn't come on until mid-November, so right now his toes are freezing.

sentences.zh: 谷歌被砸了：该抄底吗？
sentences.en: Google got hammered: time to buy the dip?

sentences.zh: Alphabet 连续几个交易日大跌，史蒂文最爱的技术指标之一——相对强弱指数（RSI）——已经进入超卖区。
sentences.en: Alphabet has dropped sharply over several straight trading days, and one of Steven's favorite technical indicators, the Relative Strength Index (RSI), has entered oversold territory.

sentences.zh: 以往股票跌到这个位置，多半是不错的买入时机。
sentences.en: In the past, when the stock fell to this level, it was usually a good time to buy.

sentences.zh: 不过这不是投资建议，请自己做好功课。
sentences.en: That said, this isn't investment advice, so please do your own homework.

sentences.zh: “钱是你的，后果你自己担，别怪我。”
sentences.en: "It's your money, you bear the consequences, so don't blame me."

sentences.zh: Meta： 走势横盘偏下，也许更适合短线交易。
sentences.en: Meta: The trend is sideways to slightly down, so it may be better suited to short-term trading.

sentences.zh: 苹果： 新款 OLED 触屏 MacBook 发布后涨到 350 见顶，此后跌了约 10%。
sentences.en: Apple: After the new OLED touchscreen MacBook launched, the stock peaked at 350 and has since fallen about 10%.

sentences.zh: “买传闻，卖事实”似乎又应验了。
sentences.en: "Buy the rumor, sell the news" seems to have proven true once again.

sentences.zh: Agnico Eagle： 这家老牌黄金股同样在走低，值得留意。
sentences.en: Agnico Eagle: This long-established gold stock is also heading lower and is worth keeping an eye on.

sentences.zh: 股票追踪表
sentences.en: Stock tracking spreadsheet

sentences.zh: 如果你是在 TikTok 上刚认识史蒂文，这里说明一下：他把节目里提过的每只股票都记在一张表格里，链接放在节目说明中。
sentences.en: If you just discovered Steven on TikTok, here's a quick explanation: he records every stock mentioned on the show in a spreadsheet, and the link is in the show notes.

sentences.zh: 今天新增了 Alphabet、Meta、苹果和 Agnico Eagle，每只都按前一天收盘价假设买入一万美元。
sentences.en: Today he added Alphabet, Meta, Apple and Agnico Eagle, each with a hypothetical $10,000 purchase at the previous day's closing price.

sentences.zh: 这只是记录，不是建议，年底前后他会回头复盘。
sentences.en: This is just a record, not advice, and he'll look back and review it around the end of the year.

sentences.zh: 糊涂加拿大人眼中的美国中期选举
sentences.en: The US midterm elections through the eyes of a confused Canadian

sentences.zh: 史蒂文坦白：他活了这么多年，一直不明白这事为什么重要，所以去问了 ChatGPT。
sentences.en: Steven confesses that after all these years he has never understood why this matters, so he went and asked ChatGPT.

sentences.zh: 原来美国人这次不是选总统，而是选出能通过、阻止、调查总统政策的议员：众议院全部席位和约三分之一的参议院席位都要改选。
sentences.en: It turns out Americans aren't electing a president this time, but rather the legislators who can pass, block and investigate the president's policies: all the seats in the House of Representatives and about one third of the seats in the Senate are up for election.

sentences.zh: 据他所闻，这可能意味着特朗普要面对两年接连不断的弹劾程序，但特朗普仍有否决权，所以不能算“跛脚鸭”。
sentences.en: From what he's heard, this could mean Trump faces two years of nonstop impeachment proceedings, but Trump still has the veto, so he can't really be called a "lame duck."

sentences.zh: 从市场角度看，ChatGPT 引用《股票交易员年鉴》说，总统任期第三年历来是表现最强的一年。
sentences.en: From a market perspective, ChatGPT cites the Stock Trader's Almanac as saying that the third year of a presidential term has historically been the strongest-performing year.

sentences.zh: 本周中国公司：砸不碎的玻璃
sentences.en: This week's Chinese company: glass that can't be smashed

sentences.zh: 本周“最难砸坏产品奖”颁给河南平顶山的一家中国玻璃厂。
sentences.en: This week's "Hardest Product to Smash Award" goes to a Chinese glass factory in Pingdingshan, Henan.

sentences.zh: 小红书和 TikTok 上到处是一段视频：法国的抗议者想砸穿它的玻璃，却怎么也砸不碎。
sentences.en: A video is all over Xiaohongshu and TikTok: French protesters try to smash through its glass, but no matter what they do, it won't break.

sentences.zh: 可惜这看起来是家私营公司，没有股票可买。
sentences.en: Unfortunately, it appears to be a private company, so there's no stock to buy.

sentences.zh: 好玻璃，锁链门
sentences.en: Good glass, chained doors

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的女朋友看了说“中国加油”，他也同意中国能造出这样的好产品是件好事。
sentences.en: Steven's girlfriend saw it and said, "Go China," and he agreed it's a good thing that China can make such a fine product.

sentences.zh: 可接着，他心里的“杠精”冒出来了：他住的楼一层有扇门，从外面被锁链拴着。
sentences.en: But then his inner contrarian popped up: on the ground floor of his building, there's a door chained shut from the outside.

sentences.zh: 一提到火灾，得到的回答通常是“不会着火的”。
sentences.en: Whenever a fire is brought up, the answer is usually, "There won't be a fire."

sentences.zh: 他说：“着不着火，可不是你说了算。”
sentences.en: He said, "Whether there's a fire or not isn't up to you."

sentences.zh: 他的公寓里有灭火器和手动消防水带，却没有自动灭火系统，而且现在只有一部电梯能用。
sentences.en: His apartment has a fire extinguisher and a manual fire hose, but no automatic fire suppression system, and right now only one elevator is working.

sentences.zh: 所以在他看来，砸不碎的玻璃只会让火灾更危险。
sentences.en: So as he sees it, unbreakable glass only makes a fire more dangerous.

sentences.zh: 加拿大取消夏令时了吗？
sentences.en: Has Canada abolished daylight saving time?

sentences.zh: 昨晚九点半，史蒂文照例去看股市，行情却没有更新。
sentences.en: At 9:30 last night, Steven went to check the stock market as usual, but the prices weren't updating.

sentences.zh: 难道是中期选举休市？
sentences.en: Could the market be closed for the midterm elections?

sentences.zh: 不是，是时钟拨回了。
sentences.en: No, the clocks had gone back.

sentences.zh: 据他了解，加拿大基本已取消夏令时，不过阿尔伯塔省和不列颠哥伦比亚省好像还在用。
sentences.en: As far as he knows, Canada has largely abolished daylight saving time, though Alberta and British Columbia seem to still use it.

sentences.zh: 现在多伦多和纽约都比北京晚 13 小时，所以美股对他来说是晚上 10 点半开盘。
sentences.en: Toronto and New York are now both 13 hours behind Beijing, so for him the US stock market opens at 10:30 p.m.

sentences.zh: 他笑说：“这一期全是我在谷歌搜索。”
sentences.en: He said with a laugh, "This whole episode is just me Googling things."

sentences.zh: 真正要紧的“期中考”
sentences.en: The "midterm" that really matters

sentences.zh: 学生们的期中考下周就到了，今天的预演让史蒂文发现，他们根本不知道该怎么做。
sentences.en: The students' midterm is next week, and today's rehearsal showed Steven that they have no idea what to do.

sentences.zh: 好在这次考试占分为零。
sentences.en: Fortunately, this exam counts for zero points.

sentences.zh: 口语考试中，四名学生要围绕一个议题的三种立场讨论约 12 分钟，要用时间、有效性、实施和成本等标准，并引用五篇文章。
sentences.en: In the oral exam, four students must discuss three positions on an issue for about 12 minutes, using criteria such as time, effectiveness, implementation and cost, and citing five articles.

sentences.zh: 结果没有一个人提到文章或标准。
sentences.en: As it turned out, not a single one of them mentioned the articles or the criteria.

sentences.zh: 不过这是第一次尝试，他本来也没抱太大期望。
sentences.en: But this was their first try, and he hadn't expected much anyway.

sentences.zh: 昨晚长达一个半小时的评分校准会很有用，因为他自己的打分偏差很大。
sentences.en: Last night's hour-and-a-half grading calibration session was very useful, because his own scoring was way off.

sentences.zh: 周五，学生们要写至少 250 词，好让他在笔试前给出反馈。
sentences.en: On Friday, the students must write at least 250 words so that he can give feedback before the written exam.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 无论是雾霾、股市，还是第一次小组讨论，看看眼前真实的情况，总比图省事随大流要好。
sentences.en: Whether it's smog, the stock market, or your first group discussion, looking at what's really in front of you is always better than taking the easy way out and following the crowd.

sentences.zh: 要是有人说“不会着火的”，你还是去看一眼那扇门吧。
sentences.en: If someone says "it won't catch fire," you should still go take a look at that door.

vocab.en: to buy at the bottom / buy the dip
a contrarian who loves to argue / nitpicker
to review and reflect on past results
